newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S DOWNHILL WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S DOWNHILL WINNER.

text.p: The following is a profile of the winner of the women's downhill at the Alpine skiing world championships on Saturday:
World Cup wins: 3. Downhill - Sierra Nevada (94), Vail (94), Lake Louise (94)

Other facts: Has reputation of saving her best for big events. Surprise silver medallist at the 1992 Albertville Olympics and bronze medallist at last year's world championships in Sierra Nevada, Spain. The 1986 junior world downhill champion. Grew up and learned to ski in Juneau, Alaska. Seriously considered retiring at the end of last season.
